## Public Notes

Full-ladder execution against the pinned v1.3.2 checkout at d88d0ed4: all TWENTY CTest targets passed (0 failed) in 1.59s under VS 2022 Win32 Debug, including the six asset-pipeline rungs (asset audit, pixelmap audit, material-file audit with binary save/load round trip, pixelmap round trip via BrPixelmapSave count semantics, material-to-face resolution rendering, file-texture sampling with palette attach), the deterministic game-shell frame loop, and the host/memory semantic rung. Defects found and fixed by execution: BrPixelmapSave returns a saved-count rather than an error code; MSVC debug-CRT report dialogs hang headless runs (suppressed under _DEBUG); br_matrix4 vs br_matrix34 declaration corruption in two rungs; game-shell path separator handling. Stale claim corrected: earth15.pix (type 4) loads completely, so the earlier partial-decode note is resolved. Finding recorded: BrMemAllocateAlign is declared in fw_p.h but unimplemented in the v1.3.2 FLOAT core.

- x64 pointer-width port is multi-site debugger work; the harness correctly guards non-Win32 targets
- interactive viewer and real display/input drivers remain to be bound onto the proven game-shell lifecycle
